summary: Yield signature verdict writer loans at a cooperative time boundary, not only a row-count boundary

replay.detail: Queued verdict work resumes from its existing durable queue.

rules.detail: Authority checks, signature verification and verdict activation are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No API or protocol changes; request deadlines are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Effective on the next normal binary rollout.

recovery.detail: After at least one claim makes progress, a loan commits before starting another claim when its 10 ms cooperative budget has elapsed. A single claim, dependency requeue page and COMMIT are not preempted and can exceed the budget.
